steps.title: Thaw Matrigel
steps.instruction: Submerge Matrigel vial on ice in a 4 °C refrigerator overnight; swirl to disperse. Store aliquots at –20 °C; keep on ice before use (liquid at 4 °C).

steps.title: Prepare complete EGM‑2 medium
steps.instruction: Add 5 mL penicillin‑streptomycin and EGM‑2 supplements to 500 mL EBM‑2; mix to obtain complete medium and aliquot 50 mL portions to prevent contamination.

steps.title: Aliquot Dispase
steps.instruction: Dispense 10 mL of Dispase into single‑use tubes and store at –20 °C until needed.

steps.title: Sterilize instruments and clean workstation
steps.instruction: Autoclave scissors and forceps; wipe dissecting microscope and work surface with 75 % ethanol; place a sterile disposable pad to create an aseptic area. Perform in a low‑traffic room.

steps.title: Set up ice‑cold culture dishes
steps.instruction: Prepare two 35 mm culture dishes (one for dissection, one for holding eyes) and keep them on ice.

steps.title: Euthanize mice and collect eyes
steps.instruction: Inject ketamine (100 mg/kg) and xylazine (10 mg/kg) intraperitoneally; enucleate eyes immediately with iris forceps; place eyes in ice‑cold EGM‑2 medium.

steps.title: Dissect choroid‑RPE fragments
steps.instruction: Using Noyes micro scissors and Dumont Dumoxel tweezers, remove cornea and lens, then separate peripheral choroid‑scleral complex from retina; cut tissue into ~1 mm × 1 mm pieces containing choroid with attached RPE. Avoid touching edges.

steps.title: Coat wells with Matrigel base
steps.instruction: Add 15 µL of cold Matrigel to the bottom of each well of a 24‑well plate without touching the edge; aim for a ~0.4 mm thickness.

steps.title: Embed choroid fragments in Matrigel
steps.instruction: Place choroid fragments into the Matrigel‑coated wells (use one eye for 6 wells; 2 mice per 24‑well plate).

steps.title: Add top Matrigel layer
steps.instruction: Overlay each well with an additional 15 µL of Matrigel; incubate plate at 37 °C for 10 min without medium to allow solidification.

steps.title: Add medium and initial incubation
steps.instruction: Add 500 µL EGM‑2 medium to each well; incubate at 37 °C, 5 % CO₂ for 48 h before any treatment.

steps.title: Medium changes and imaging
steps.instruction: Replace medium every 48 h; acquire daily phase‑contrast images of each explant with a Leica DMi8 microscope.

steps.title: Digest Matrigel with Dispase
steps.instruction: After 6 days, discard medium, wash wells once with plain PBS, add 500 µL Dispase per well, and incubate at 37 °C for 2 h.

steps.title: Filter through 100 µm strainer
steps.instruction: Collect the digested suspension into a 50 mL centrifuge tube and pass it through a 100 µm cell strainer into the same tube to obtain a single‑cell suspension.

steps.title: Centrifuge cell suspension
steps.instruction: Spin at 300 × g for 5 min; discard supernatant.

steps.title: Resuspend and count cells
steps.instruction: Resuspend pellet in 500 µL EGM‑2 medium and determine cell number using a TC20 automated cell counter.

steps.title: Block Fc receptors and label CD31
steps.instruction: Add 20 µL FcR blocking reagent per 1 × 10⁷ cells, vortex briefly, then add 20 µL CD31 MicroBeads; incubate on ice (4 °C) for 15 min, avoiding prolonged exposure.

steps.title: Centrifuge and resuspend labeled cells
steps.instruction: Spin at 300 × g for 3 min; discard supernatant and resuspend pellet in 1 mL EGM‑2 medium.

steps.title: Prepare LS magnetic columns
steps.instruction: Rinse each LS column with 3 mL EGM‑2 medium.

steps.title: Filter through 40 µm strainer
steps.instruction: Pass the cell suspension through a 40 µm cell strainer to remove aggregates before loading onto the LS column.

steps.title: Load and wash magnetic column
steps.instruction: Apply the filtered suspension onto the LS column; wash the column three times with 3 mL EGM‑2 medium, adding buffer only when the column reservoir is empty.

steps.title: Elute CD31‑positive cells
steps.instruction: Pipette 5 mL EGM‑2 onto the column and push the plunger to flush out labeled cells; repeat twice more for a total elution volume of 15 mL.

steps.title: Centrifuge eluted cells
steps.instruction: Spin eluate at 300 × g for 5 min; discard supernatant.

steps.title: Resuspend CD31‑positive cells
steps.instruction: Resuspend the pellet in 10 mL EGM‑2 medium to obtain CD31‑positive cells; culture at 37 °C, 5 % CO₂ and change medium every other day.

steps.title: Prepare PBST buffer
steps.instruction: Mix 500 mL 1× PBS with 250 µL Tween‑20 (0.05 % v/v) to a final volume of 500 mL; store at room temperature.

steps.title: Prepare permeabilization buffer
steps.instruction: Mix 500 mL 1× PBS with 250 µL Triton X‑100 (0.05 % v/v) to a final volume of 500 mL; store at room temperature.

steps.title: Prepare TBST buffer
steps.instruction: Dilute 100 mL 10× TBS to 1× with 900 mL water, then add 500 µL Tween‑20 (0.05 % v/v) for a total of 1 L; store at room temperature.

steps.title: Prepare 5 % milk blocking buffer
steps.instruction: Combine 30 mL TBST (1×) with 1.5 g non‑fat milk (5 % w/v); prepare fresh before use.

steps.title: Fix cells for immunofluorescence
steps.instruction: Add 4 % (vol/vol) paraformaldehyde in PBS to cells on 8‑well slides; incubate 15 min at room temperature, then rinse with 1× PBS for 5 min at room temperature.

steps.title: Permeabilize cells
steps.instruction: Incubate cells with permeabilization buffer for 20 min at room temperature.

steps.title: Block non‑specific binding
steps.instruction: Incubate cells in 10 % normal goat serum for 1 h at room temperature.

steps.title: Primary antibody incubation
steps.instruction: Dilute ACTA2 antibody 1:100 in 10 % goat serum; apply to cells and incubate overnight at 4 °C in a humidified chamber.

steps.title: Wash after primary antibody
steps.instruction: Wash cells three times with PBST, 5 min each at room temperature.

steps.title: Secondary antibody incubation
steps.instruction: Dilute Alexa Fluor 594‑conjugated goat anti‑mouse secondary 1:250 in 10 % goat serum; incubate 1 h at room temperature in the dark.

steps.title: Wash after secondary antibody
steps.instruction: Wash cells three times with PBST, 5 min each at room temperature.

steps.title: Nuclear staining with DAPI
steps.instruction: Incubate cells with DAPI (1 µg/mL) for 5 min at room temperature.

steps.title: Mount slides for imaging
steps.instruction: Detach the cell chamber, place the slide glass side up, add a drop of VECTASHIELD antifade mounting medium, cover with a coverslip, press gently to flatten, and image with a confocal microscope.

steps.title: Homogenize cells for western blot
steps.instruction: Lyse cells in RIPA buffer supplemented with 1 % phosphatase inhibitor and 1 % protease inhibitor cocktail.

steps.title: Determine protein concentration
steps.instruction: Measure protein amount using the Pierce BCA Protein Assay kit according to the manufacturer’s protocol.

steps.title: Run SDS‑PAGE and transfer
steps.instruction: Separate proteins on a 10 % SDS‑PAGE gel and electro‑transfer onto Cytiva Amersham Hybond PVDF membranes.

steps.title: Block membrane with milk
steps.instruction: Incubate membranes in 5 % non‑fat milk blocking buffer for 1 h at room temperature.

steps.title: Primary antibody incubation for blot
steps.instruction: Incubate membranes with antibodies against ACTA2, SM22α, COL1, CD31, and β‑actin (overnight, temperature not specified).

steps.title: Wash blot after primary
steps.instruction: Wash membranes three times with TBST, 10 min each at room temperature.

steps.title: Secondary antibody incubation
steps.instruction: Incubate membranes with HRP‑linked anti‑mouse or anti‑rabbit IgG secondary antibodies for 1 h at room temperature.

steps.title: Wash blot after secondary
steps.instruction: Wash membranes three times with TBST, 10 min each at room temperature.

steps.title: Detect and image proteins
steps.instruction: Apply Immobilon Forte Western HRP substrate and capture chemiluminescent images using a ChemiDoc MP system.

description: Validation of protocol A. Immunofluorescence To characterize the vascular sprouts from the choroid, which exhibit tube-like growth cones of ECs, we cultured sprouts from Cdh5 Cre ; Rosa26-EYFP f/f mice. In these mice, ECs are fate-mapped with the Rosa26-stop-EYFP (enhanced yellow fluorescent protein) reporter. As shown in Figure 3 , ECs were EYFP-positive. After treatment with mTGFβ2 (10 ng/mL) for three days, EYFP-positive ECs expressed the endothelial-to-mesenchymal transition marker ACTA2, suggesting that a subset of ECs had transdifferentiated into mesenchymal cells. Figure 3. Choroidal sprouting immunostaining. Representative EYFP and ACTA2 immunostaining of choroidal sprouting at Day 6 isolated and cultured from Cdh5 Cre ; Rosa26 -EYFP f/f mice and treated with or without mTGFβ2 (10 ng/mL) for 3 days. Scale bar, 200 μm. 1. Fix the cells on 8-well cell culture slides with 4% (vol/vol) PFA in PBS for 15 min at room temperature (RT). Next, rinse with 1× plain PBS for 5 min at RT. 2. After fixation, permeabilize with permeabilization buffer for 20 min at RT. 3. Block with 10% normal goat serum for 1 h at RT. 4. Incubate with primary antibody against ACTA2 diluted 1/100 (vol/vol) in 10% normal goat serum at 4 °C overnight in a humidified chamber. 5. Remove the primary antibody and wash it three times with PBST for 5 min at RT. 6. Incubate with Alexa Fluor 594-conjugated goat anti-mouse secondary antibody diluted 1/250 (vol/vol) in 10% normal goat serum for 1 h at RT in the dark. 7. Remove the secondary antibody and wash it three times with PBST for 5 min at RT. 8. Incubate the cells for 5 min with DAPI dye (1 μg/mL) to stain the nuclei. 9. Carefully detach the cell chamber and position the glass slide with the cell side facing upward. 10. To mount, pipette a drop of VECTASHIELD antifade mounting medium onto the slide.
